corrected_record.exposure_duration_and_schedule: reconditioning exposure to 2 uM 5-AZA for 12 days; total RNA extracted after 3 and 5 days of culture without 5-AZA (T1 and T2)
corrected_record.result_value: increased—ALB, SLC10A1, CYP3A4, and miR-122 significantly induced, indicating restored hepatic differentiation; no ALB induction in Hep3B (already elevated ~7.5-fold in non-reconditioned Hep3B versus HepG2)
corrected_record.extra_details: Phenotype named: restoration of hepatocyte differentiation markers (differentiated-function/reserve endpoint). Non-reconditioned HCC cells were used as controls. CYP1A2, TAT, G6Pc, and HNF4A mRNAs also upregulated in reconditioned cells; CDH1 augmented; AFP downregulated. Exposure regimen classified as repeated_dose_with_recovery because cells were cultured without 5-AZA (3 and 5 days) before RNA assessment.
